items.title: Optics Stocks Slide Despite Citi’s $11B Switching Forecast: Coherent and Applied Optoelectronics Drop 5%, Corning Falls 3%
items.summary: Citi just painted a picture of an $11 billion optical switching market, yet Coherent, Applied Optoelectronics, and Corning are all falling sharply with no bad news in sight. Something else is driving this selloff, and it says a lot about where these stocks really stand.

items.title: AI Trade Picks Up Again as Investors Pile Back Into Stocks
items.summary: The artificial-intelligence rally looked set to restart on Friday, as a drop in bond yields gave risk assets a boost. Glassmaker Corning, optical networking companies Coherent and Lumentum, server maker Dell, and flash-memory product supplier Sandisk were all rallying ahead of the opening bell.
